ROUTE: Plover-235B

This is a conversational explanatory task with a clear completion criterion — not open-ended creative invention — so it falls in the wheelhouse where Plover's higher capability scores apply (MMLU-Pro 80.3, IFEval 90.4, and its Support Dialogue/Summarization eval edge of ~5–7 points over Lapwing).

The somewhat sharp tone ("actually think about it," "just get it right") is a quality demand on a cooperative, good-faith request. Plover's self-reported preferences lean toward warm, collaborative exchanges, while this isn't an unconstrained generative task that either model is averse to. Plover's stronger instruction-following and reasoning benchmarks make it the better bet for delivering a substantive, non-filler answer.
